name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: REINIT-CERTVERIFIER-EXPERIMENT BUILD (v2, detailed logging), not for production: 0.4.31's CertVerifier rebuild (toggling security.enterprise_roots.enabled false->true) also had zero observable effect on the self-heal pattern -- same as 0.4.30's PK11 token logout/login before it. This build adds explicit, timestamped step-by-step logging around reinitCertVerifier() (including a timeout on the psm:enterprise-certs-imported wait, since a silent hang was previously indistinguishable from success) to confirm whether the reinit itself is actually succeeding, or failing silently inside its try/catch -- for cross-referencing against a MOZ_LOG=CMS:5,MIMECRYPT:5,pipnss:4,certverifier:4,timestamp capture around the second, non-self-healing occurrence.
